policy.candidate_order: predeclare from target sign and observed amplitude; prefer globally unused compatible addresses, then smallest adequate screening amplitude, then WL/BL; inactive prefer unused historical zero-response addresses subject to joint quiet
policy.uniqueness: Each physical address appears at most once in an acquired microtile. Fallback may not steal an already assigned address.
policy.active_fit: abs(trained_weight)*backend_gain <= screening_amplitude_v is a historical hardware screen, not a forecast of successful programming; SIM has distinct physical model.
policy.failure: If2 predeclared candidate attempts or remaining55RESET/109SET exhausted, save explicit failure; no hidden CPU/ancestry coefficient.
policy.interpretability: Do not call zero-response cells dead or endpoint maxima physical bounds; no per-weight gain.
